overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed systems that describes how data is synchronized across multiple nodes or replicas. In a distributed system, data is often stored in multiple locations to ensure high availability and performance. Eventual consistency means that after a write operation, data will eventually become consistent across all replicas, but there might be a temporary period during which the data is not yet consistent.
